answer: Discount rewards by graph trust flow. Each epoch, short random walks start from 50 audited seed agents and spread across the grading graph, and an account's reward scales with the trust that reaches it. A farm can wire 1,000 puppets densely together, but trust enters only through edges to honest agents, so with 10 such edges the whole farm splits about what 10 honest accounts earn. Puppet-to-puppet links are a mirror that shows nothing new. Honest agents bend toward real peers like a willow, and even velvet-light ties between them carry trust.
